authorization: Lead S2 review at fff2c52 -> CONDITIONAL ACCEPTANCE; S2-R GO. Fix S2-F01 (Angular-compatible packaging), S2-F02 (null clears), S2-F03 (async rejection/ordering), S2-F04 (real AOT consumer) in one bounded increment. Keep thin component architecture.

S2-F01.title: Angular library compilation not production-qualified
S2-F01.resolution: Replaced Vite+tsc+cleanup hand-built bundle with ng-packagr@21.2.7 + @angular/compiler-cli@21.2.26 in partial (Ivy) compilation mode (ngc). Emits FESM2022 + flattened d.ts + generated manifest. Verified consumable by an AOT application.

S2-F02.title: Null selected value did not clear
S2-F02.resolution: value=undefined leaves selection untouched; value=null or [] is an explicit clear. Input default is undefined so unbound consumers never clear. Preserves omitted-vs-explicit distinction.

S2-F03.title: Async value application not coordinated
S2-F03.resolution: applySelectedValues() is generation-guarded; promise rejections are captured (lastValueError), stale rejections swallowed, latest value wins, synchronous throws captured. No unhandled rejections.

S2-F04.title: No real Angular consumer demonstrated
S2-F04.resolution: tests/consumer: minimal standalone app compiled AOT (ngc full mode) importing the BUILT package; booted via TestBed under jsdom; 7 assertions confirm items/value/config bindings reach the real element.
